text:
```yaml
name: No Response

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Run daily at midnight
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read
  issues: write
  pull-requests: write

jobs:
  no-response:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Close stale issues and PRs
        uses: actions/stale@v9
        with:
          stale-issue-message: |
            This issue has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            
            If you believe this issue is still valid, please leave a comment or reaction to keep it open.
            
            For more information, see our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/kubb-labs/kubb/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
          stale-pr-message: |
            This pull request has been automatically marked as stale because it has not had recent activity. It will be closed if no further activity occurs.
            
            If you believe this pull request is still valid, please leave a comment or reaction to keep it open.
            
            For more information, see our [contributing guidelines](https://github.com/kubb-labs/kubb/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
          close-issue-message: |
            This issue was closed because it has not had recent activity and was marked as stale.
          close-pr-message: |
            This pull request was closed because it has not had recent activity and was marked as stale.
          days-before-stale: 30
          days-before-close: 7
          exempt-issue-labels: 'bug,enhancement,documentation,help wanted'
          exempt-pr-labels: 'bug,enhancement,documentation,help wanted'
          stale-issue-label: 'stale'
          stale-pr-label: 'stale'
          operations-per-run: 100
          remove-stale-when-updated: true
          only-issue-labels: 'needs-response'
          only-pr-labels: 'needs-response'
          debug-only: false
```
